content:
There's an annoying iPhone notification bug affecting some iOS 27 users. Affected users will see a red badge on the Settings app, prompting them to "Enable iCloud Storage."

However, tapping the alert only takes you to the iCloud storage purchase screen, and even if you close it, the alert won't go away. Even users who already have plenty of iCloud storage, such as those on a 2TB family Apple One plan, are still seeing this problematic notification.

Although Apple occasionally uses the Settings app to promote offers (such as Apple TV trials) and remind users about AppleCare coverage, this particular notification appears to be simply a glitch, not a borderline tactic to hard-sell an iCloud upgrade plan.

The notification appears on devices running iOS 27 and iOS 27.2 official releases, as well as iOS 26.7.

Some users have reported that signing out of their Apple account on the device and signing back in causes the alert to disappear. Hopefully Apple can fix this soon via a backend adjustment.

Update: Apple Support advises users to sign out of their "Media & Purchases" account on the device and sign back in. Please go to Settings -> [Your Name] -> Media & Purchases -> Sign Out, then sign back in.
